description: Runs every journey in a ai-tag-debugger config file and writes the report. With against, the run is checked against a saved plan and, if the config has no journeys, walks the journeys derived from that plan. With scripted true, it replays each journey's fixed steps and needs no API key. Otherwise the journeys are browsed by the AI provider configured on this computer (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY or GEMINI_API_KEY). Returns the findings.

against.description: A saved plan to check against: latest (or last), first, a plan ID such as 2026-10-16_0627, or on a local server a path to a plan file or folder. Plans are the ones saved by `aitd plan --site <url>`. The site comes from the config.

baseline.description: Path to a baseline file of accepted findings, written by the CLI with --update-baseline. Default: the config's "baseline". Accepted findings are listed but not counted.

branding.description: Set false to leave the Analitik İşler logo and credit line out of the report.

concurrency.description: How many journeys to run at once, each in its own browser. Default 1.

config.description: Path to the config file, e.g. ai-tag-debugger.config.json

providers.description: Tracking providers to check. Default ga4, google_ads, meta, tiktok plus any other known platform the site sends to. When given, requests to the others are still answered locally, but they are only counted, not shown or checked.

scripted.description: Replay fixed steps instead of browsing with an AI model. Default true.

name: run_audit
title: Run a configured audit
